body:
Raised/recorded: 2026-10-05 (America/Los_Angeles). Bounded follow-up from [#422](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/issues/422) and its evidence PR [#994](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/pull/994). Findings are provisional until the packet merges.

## Goal

Resolve the 84-feature 2016 geoBoundaries MKD ADM2 collection against the State Statistical Office’s 80-unit current NTES level-4 roster and the official spatial-units register. Establish exact obsolete/merged unit crosswalks, date/vintage meaning, and whether any province-parent naming/role proposal is warranted for the eight listed parents. Do not infer corrections from counts alone; compare sourced units/geometry, retain source/licence evidence, and hand any shared hierarchy/source-catalog edit to engineering.

## Acceptance

- Research every exact subject and its relevant parent relationship using authoritative dated sources.
- Retain lawful original source bytes or explicit retrieval/restoration instructions; record URLs, retrieval dates, vintages, hashes, completeness and license limits.
- Reproduce exact ID crosswalks and methods; report unsupported/uncertain cases honestly.
- Provide evidence-backed, ID-preserving correction/source-restoration recommendations and explicit engineering handoffs.
- Do not edit shared geography, publish, import, or certify the area/region.

Do not claim legal boundary accuracy from counts, aggregate area, topology or source labels alone. Preserve old evidence and Atlas IDs. This is source-only geography research and authorizes no boundary mutation, regional approval or historical import.
